entries.label: SS18::SSX1

sections.text: SS18::SSX1 incorporates into BAF chromatin-remodeling complexes and displaces wild-type SS18 and BAF47, altering transcriptional regulation. It is a characteristic fusion of synovial sarcoma.

Afamitresgene autoleucel is US-approved for adults with unresectable or metastatic synovial sarcoma after chemotherapy who have one of the specified HLA-A*02 alleles and whose tumors express MAGE-A4. SS18::SSX detection alone does not establish cellular-therapy eligibility.

curation_notes: SSX4 is rare; the mechanistic studies establish the SS18::SSX class, not equivalent outcome data for all partners.
Fusion status alone does not establish eligibility for antigen/HLA-restricted cellular therapy.
